Prep time: 20 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Chill time: 30 minutes Total time: 50 minutes Number of Servings: 8 Ingredients 1 1/2 cups finely chopped fresh strawberries (about 1/2 pound) 1/2 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped 1/4 cup finely chopped onion 2 Tablespoons chopped cilantro 1 1/2 teaspoons lime juice Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl. Flavors will blend if refrigerated for 30 minutes or more before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Try adding to tacos or wraps.
